**T06 second-stage contract recheck failed. Blocking 2, should_fix 0.** Both focused runs passed **85/85** tests, comprising 71 metrics and 14 team tests. The source-CLI probes matched **187/193** current-contract expectations. Six mismatches reproduced the two blockers below. This was an independent Codex recheck with the same OpenAI provider. [Counts and raw results](/tmp/pace-t06-r20-ind.kvm0GY/summary.json)

### Blocking findings

1. **T-4 · Unicode separators can create or end a retrospective section.** In otherwise valid synthetic close files, `ordinary paragraph\u2028## 회고` and `## 회고\u2029later text` each let `project finish P001` return **0**, where the expected exit was **1**. Local Markdown rendering showed no exact `회고` heading in either file. A third fixture had a genuine `## 회고` heading, but `ordinary paragraph\u2028## 일반 본문` inside that section caused `finish` to return **1** instead of **0**. The multiline regex treats U+2028 and U+2029 as line boundaries even though the Markdown projection keeps them on the same line. [Section selection](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:46) · [Reproduction](/tmp/pace-t06-r20-ind.kvm0GY/changed/ls-fake-root-heading/input-close.md:19) · [CLI results](/tmp/pace-t06-r20-ind.kvm0GY/changed.json:127) · [Markdown rendering](/tmp/pace-t06-r20-ind.kvm0GY/render.log)

2. **T-4 · A visually empty summary, evidence-link label, or header still passes.** I replaced each cell separately with a single U+3164 HANGUL FILLER. All three fixtures returned **0**, where the expected exit was **1**. The shared validator accepts this character because its Unicode category is `Lo`. The local Korean font rendered it with width but zero ink. A visible Hangul control passed. [Cell validator](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:41) · [Summary fixture](/tmp/pace-t06-r20-ind.kvm0GY/visibility/hangul-filler-summary/input-close.md:23) · [CLI results](/tmp/pace-t06-r20-ind.kvm0GY/visibility.json) · [Font measurement](/tmp/pace-t06-r20-ind.kvm0GY/render.log)

### Contract and scope

**Upper-goal alignment holds.** BR01 defines request reach, BR09 supplies the ledger, BR06 measures and compares, and BR07 consumes the retrospective evidence. The documented column-zero headings, block boundaries, and canonical three-column table suffice for those goals. Both findings affect the explicit requirements for an actual retrospective section and visible cell content. **T-4 and T06 acceptance remain unmet.** [T06 criteria](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/projects/P009_261123_프로젝트_맞춤_에이전트_팀/tasks/T06_팀_측정과_회고/TASK.md:26) · [P009 goals](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/projects/P009_261123_프로젝트_맞춤_에이전트_팀/PROJECT.md:22)

Service IDs and local SHA-256 receipts passed, and malformed/path receipts failed. Legacy FIFO held at six seconds, old responsibility prose passed, and finish warned about the open delegation. I ran `node --test test/team-metrics.test.ts test/team.test.ts` with Node `v24.22.3`. The source probes invoked `node bin/pace.ts` from temporary Git fixtures with synthetic `PACE_HOME` directories. I preserved the original replay and reran one expectation with the current rule that an empty link label is invalid even beside visible prose. The current-contract replay then matched **150/150**, and the 43 additional probes matched **37/43**. The candidate passed `git apply --reverse --check`, and the worktree status matched its pre-run snapshot.
